notes:
Same as 2.05, with a note added to the troubleshooting recorder.

Two tablets were still handing out the same piston number after 2.05, and there are three possible reasons that look identical from the outside. Rather than change the behaviour again on a guess, this build writes down everything it used to pick a number each time you place a piston — which ink layer you are on, which memory level, how many generals the organ is recorded as having, and which numbers it believes are already taken.

Placing one piston on each tablet is enough to say which of the three it is.

Nothing else is different from 2.05, and the note costs nothing: one line, only when you place a piston.
